serverstats.label: Server counters
serverstats.description: Voice channels whose name shows a server statistic, updated automatically.

g0.label: 📊 Counters
g0.description: Each counter renames a voice channel with a server statistic.

counters.label: Counters
counters.help: One row per counter channel: its type, and a name template where {count} is replaced by the value. The bot renames the channel periodically — Discord rate-limits channel renames hard (twice per ten minutes), so a counter refreshes within minutes, not seconds. Voice channels locked to 0 connections make the best counters: nobody can enter, everybody sees them.

refreshAll.label: Refresh the counters
refreshAll.help: Immediately renames every counter channel with its current value.
